realisticcruelty.configuration.title: RealisticCruelty Configuration
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_amo: Multiplier applied to the damage-based amount of blood particles generated by an attack.
Additional number of blood particles added to every blood splatter effect.
Maximum number of blood particles that can be generated by a single blood splatter effect.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_spe: Multiplier applied to the damage-based speed of generated blood particles.
Additional speed added to generated blood particles.
Maximum speed of generated blood particles.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_gen: Minimum multiplier applied to the speed of blood particles generated by general damage.
Maximum multiplier applied to the speed of blood particles generated by general damage.
Maximum angular spread of blood particles generated by general damage, in degrees.
Whether blood mist is generated for general damage.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_mel: Minimum multiplier applied to the speed of blood particles generated by melee attacks.
Maximum multiplier applied to the speed of blood particles generated by melee attacks.
Maximum angular spread of blood particles generated by melee attacks, in degrees.
Whether blood mist is generated for melee attacks.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_pro: Minimum multiplier applied to the speed of blood particles generated by projectile damage.
Maximum multiplier applied to the speed of blood particles generated by projectile damage.
Maximum angular spread of blood particles generated by projectile damage, in degrees.
Whether blood mist is generated for projectile damage.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_exp: Minimum multiplier applied to the speed of blood particles generated by explosions.
Maximum multiplier applied to the speed of blood particles generated by explosions.
Maximum angular spread of blood particles generated by explosions, in degrees.
Whether blood mist is generated for explosion damage.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_dep: Distance that blood particles are offset from the surface they hit. Increasing this value can help prevent z-fighting.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_fog: Distance that blood mist is offset from the surface it hits. Increasing this value can help prevent z-fighting.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_spl: Whether blood stains are created when blood particles collide with blocks.
How long blood stains remain visible after being created.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_fog: Multiplier applied to the damage-based size of blood mist.
Additional size added to generated blood mist.
Maximum size of generated blood mist.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_spl: Minimum number of additional blood splashes created when blood particles collide with blocks.
Maximum number of additional blood splashes created when blood particles collide with blocks.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_sou: Sound played when a blood splatter effect is generated.
realisticcruelty.configuration.blood_vol: Minimum volume multiplier for blood splatter sounds.
Maximum volume multiplier for blood splatter sounds.
realisticcruelty.configuration.fragment_: Sound played when a creature produces a fragment effect instead of blood.
Minimum volume multiplier for fragment effect sounds.
Maximum volume multiplier for fragment effect sounds.
realisticcruelty.configuration.client_go: Minimum amount of gore generated by client-side gore effects.
Maximum amount of gore generated by client-side gore effects.
realisticcruelty.configuration.gore_blac: List of entities that are excluded from gore effects. When the whitelist option is enabled, this list is treated as a whitelist instead.
realisticcruelty.configuration.gore_use_: Whether the gore entity list is used as a whitelist instead of a blacklist.
realisticcruelty.configuration.gore_colo: Custom blood and gore colors for specific entities.
Default blood and gore color used for entities without a custom color.
realisticcruelty.configuration.gore_text: Items used as textures for custom gore fragments.
realisticcruelty.configuration.gore_gene: Damage types that can trigger general gore effects.
realisticcruelty.configuration.gore_expl: Damage types that are treated as explosions when determining gore effects.
realisticcruelty.configuration.clientGor: Whether gore effects are rendered entirely on the client, without requiring the server to have RealisticCruelty installed.
